description: Function signature is pub fn sc081_validity_cap(now_unix: u64) -> u64 but the doc comment and correct usage requires the certificate's notBefore, not the relying-party's current time. Any caller reading only the signature will pass the wrong value. Fix: rename parameter to not_before_unix. File: pkix-profiles/src/lib.rs line 333.
title: profiles: sc081_validity_cap parameter named now_unix should be not_before_unix
